the addition of BC to recycled paper improves the mechanical, physical, optical, and filler retention properties of paper.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BCNF can be used as a sustainable alternative to synthetic additives to improve paper quality.
low-fibrillated BCNF is a sustainable alternative for the improvement of recycled paper properties.
the addition of low fibrillated BCNF to recycled paper improves the mechanical properties of handsheets and increases the filler retention, without compromising the optical properties of paper.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of 1-3% of BCNF to the recycled paper pulp can improve the mechanical properties of the paper, making it a sustainable alternative to the use of chemical additives.
BCNF of low degree of fibrillation can be added to the paper network in order to improve its properties without compromising the tear index.
the use of BCNF to enhance paper strength does not necessarily imply the decrease of other paper properties, such as tear index and flexibility.
